Hero section

Webby @neropursue2026-08-24inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Brutalist hero section: split layout - left 'COMMAND THE DIGITAL / UNSTOPPABLE, SOVEREIGN' headline with Book-a-Call CTA and 3 helmet-render thumbnails; right a classical marble bust wearing a futuristic HUD visor. The visor FX loop: glitch RGB splits, scanline bands, a targeting reticle over one eye, and an orbiting gold ring, cycling through visor states.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-25%
Bust with dark visor band, red orbital accent near the eye; faint HUD brackets frame the head; thumbnails static.
25-50%
Visor glitches: horizontal slice offsets + RGB channel split; a gold elliptical ring orbits across the eye line; scanline texture sweeps down.
50-75%
Reticle state: crosshair brackets + gold ring lock over the right eye, red dot centered; brief hold, then glitch again.
75-100%
FX settle back to dark visor; neck/shoulders keep a slow red ember glow pulse; loop.

Build prompt

Build a brutalist hero with a HUD visor loop. Layout: 60/40 split - left column: nav row, giant condensed headline 'COMMAND THE DIGITAL' with the second line in outline style, 2-line muted sub, black 'Book A Call' button + ghost link, and a row of 3 small render thumbnails (grayscale, hover colorizes). Right: full-height marble-bust photo, grey-graded. The visor is 4 overlay layers on the bust's eye band, driven by a 6s timeline: (1) scanlines - a repeating-linear-gradient band (2px lines, 8% white) sweeping translateY 0->100% over 2s; (2) glitch - 2-3 horizontal slice divs (background = bust image, position-offset) that snap translateX +-8px with hue-shifted duplicates (red/cyan channel copies, mix-blend-mode screen) in 150ms stepped bursts; (3) reticle - corner-bracket SVG that scales 1.4->1 over the eye (300ms ease-out) with a pulsing red center dot, holds 800ms; (4) a gold elliptical ring (border, rotated 75deg) orbiting via rotate 360deg/2s around the eye. Sequence: glitch burst -> orbit pass -> reticle lock -> glitch -> idle 2s. Neck glow: red radial gradient at 8% opacity pulsing 4s sine.
